steps.rule: The edge of a control people must find.
steps.pick: neutral.500: the edge of a control people must find, 4.76:1 on surface.default, above the 3:1 floor.
steps.darkPick: neutral.400: the edge of a control people must find, 6.97:1 on surface.default, above the 3:1 floor.

steps.pick: neutral.600: the quietest text that still reads, 7.02:1 on surface.default, above the 4.5:1 floor.
steps.darkPick: neutral.400: the quietest text that still reads, 6.97:1 on surface.default, above the 4.5:1 floor.

steps.question: What is the main content?
steps.why: Product pages, sign-up and account forms.

steps.question: Which text roles does it need?
steps.why: One set of roles across brands.

steps.rule: A recessed fill, a step below content.
steps.pick: neutral.100, a step below content (1.1:1 on surface.default), so table headers and wells read as recessed.
steps.darkPick: neutral.0: We use one step darker than content for table headers and wells in dark, in order to show depth by tone, 1.13:1 on surface.default. The darker fill does this by the depth rule turned downward: what sits lower is darker. So a well reads as recessed and never as a raised card, because dark ships as standard (theming.values) and depth reads from tone and lines (elevation.definition).

steps.pick: neutral.700: supporting text, 10.35:1 on surface.default, above the 4.5:1 floor.
steps.darkPick: neutral.500: supporting text, 12.02:1 on surface.default, above the 4.5:1 floor.

steps.pick: neutral.900: the strongest text step, 17.85:1 on surface.default, above the 4.5:1 floor.
steps.darkPick: neutral.900: the strongest text step, 17.06:1 on surface.default, above the 4.5:1 floor.

steps.question: How much is on one screen?

steps.why: Customers browse on phones, and compact rows are hard to tap in any brand.
Prices sit in sentences and offers, not in columns to compare, so a mono font adds nothing in any brand.

steps.rule: Quiet edges and dividers. Decorative, so it has no contrast minimum.
steps.pick: neutral.200: a quiet line that stays visible on every surface it meets (lowest 1.18:1, on surface.canvas). It decorates, so it holds no contrast minimum.
steps.darkPick: neutral.200: a quiet line that stays visible on every surface it meets (lowest 1.41:1, on surface.raised). It decorates, so it holds no contrast minimum.

steps.pick: neutral.900: the strongest text step, 17.85:1 on surface.default, above the 4.5:1 floor.
steps.darkPick: neutral.900: the strongest text step, 17.06:1 on surface.default, above the 4.5:1 floor.

steps.pick: inter for data text: Each brand brings its own face, Inter, Plus Jakarta Sans or Poppins, on one shared type scale, so brands differ and the system stays one.

steps.question: Which states get their own visible value?

steps.why: Motion is shared, so one component library behaves the same in every brand.

steps.rule: The fill of the item the pointer or the keyboard is on, or whose submenu is open. A state shows on the item's background, one step from the surfaces it sits on: darker in light, and darker in dark too, as raised layers take the lighter step.
steps.pick: neutral.100, two steps darker than the surfaces it sits on (neutral.0), so the item under the pointer or the keyboard reads as a band without lifting off the page. It skips neutral.50, the page canvas, so a menu item never matches the page behind it.
steps.darkPick: neutral.0: We use a step darker than content for the item under the pointer or the keyboard in dark, in order to mark it as a band on both surfaces it meets: 1.13:1 on surface.default and 1.38:1 on surface.raised. The fill does this by stepping darker, as raised layers took the lighter step; muted text still reads 7.88:1 on it. So the hovered row or menu item shows on cards and menus alike, because hover and focus have their own look (accessibility.roles) and the neutral ramp sets the steps (color.definition).

steps.question: How many signals carry each meaning?
steps.why: Brand colors vary, so meaning needs a word.

steps.rule: The fill of a selected or current item, or a toggle that is on.
steps.pick: teal.light.100: a tint of the brand, 1.15:1 from content, always beside its edge (border.selected), so selection is never color alone.
steps.darkPick: teal.dark.100: a tint of the brand, 1.18:1 from content, always beside its edge (border.selected), so selection is never color alone.

steps.rule: The edge that marks a selected item, beside its fill, so selection is never color alone.
steps.pick: teal.light.600: the edge beside a selected fill, so selection is never color alone, 5.47:1 on surface.default, above the 3:1 floor.
steps.darkPick: teal.dark.600: the edge beside a selected fill, so selection is never color alone, 9.9:1 on surface.default, above the 3:1 floor.
